title: Completion Period and Closure — Marlowe & Finch Gift Registry
content:
The completion period of a Marlowe & Finch Gift Registry opens on the event date less the registry type's opening figure in calendar days, and ends at the end of the event date plus the registry type's closing figure in calendar days; after that the registry closes, which is the closure basis of every registry type.

### Lifecycle of the period

| Moment | Registry status | Made by |
|---|---|---|
| Before the completion period opens | active | — |
| Opening day of the completion period | becomes completion | the registry system |
| Day after the last day of the completion period | becomes closed; remaining registry credit is converted | the registry system |

### Rules of the period

- Both dates follow the current event date.
- A registry whose completion period has opened keeps the dates it opened with.
- Opening and closing are made by the registry system. Customer care never opens a completion period early and never extends it.

### Derived dates (hypothetical)

A registry type with an opening figure of 0 days and a closing figure of 90 days, with a current event date of 1 April:
- the completion period opens on 1 April;
- it runs through the whole of 30 June (90 calendar days after 1 April) and the registry closes after that day.

If, before 1 April, the event date had been moved to 15 April, both dates would follow the new date: opening on 15 April, ending at the end of 14 July. Once the period has opened, its dates no longer move.

### Basis Q&A

**Can customer care open the completion period a few days early for a registrant?** No; opening is made only by the registry system.

**Does the period run through the last counted day?** Yes; it ends at the end of that day.
